findings.issue: `factorDegrees_eq_singleton_iff_irreducible` assumes `f.Monic`, but the underlying field-level iff needs no hypothesis at all: `Multiset.map natDegree (normalizedFactors g) = {g.natDegree} ↔ Irreducible g` for any `g : K[X]` (if the multiset is a singleton then `normalizedFactors g ≠ 0`, hence `g ≠ 0` by `normalizedFactors_zero`, and `prod_normalizedFactors` applies). `factorDegrees_eq_singleton` (line 121) is the ← half of that same general iff.

summary: The carrier definition is roadmap-pinned to ℤ/ZMod p, but three of the file's substantive proofs are field-level or ring-hom-level facts stated only in the ℤ-to-ZMod p specialization; the general statements should be proved first (in Discriminant.lean and a UFM/polynomial lemma) and the ZMod versions derived. One lemma also carries an avoidable `Monic` hypothesis.
